The Authentic Name

Why njord.com is the correct form

Old Norse Original

Njord

The name in its original Old Norse form. The original script is preserved in scholarly transliteration systems.

ASCII Constraint

NJORD

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Njord

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
njord.com → njord.com

The non-ASCII characters in Njord are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Njord.

Tier Classification

Why Njord is classified as Tier-2 Basic

The Old Norse original Njord contains only no distinctive phonetic features. This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 name. The Unicode restoration preserves what can be preserved — honoring the single feature that distinguishes it from plain ASCII.
